transkript.t: Peter, are you telling me someone just copied clawed design, made it open source, removed the paywall, and released it onto the internet like a biological weapon?
Wait, free?
Yep, it's called open design, and it basically works like clawed design, but without usage limits or subscriptions.
Ah, yes, the developer community's favorite hobby, seeing a paid product and saying, nah, we can build that.
So what does it actually do?
You prompt it with ideas, and it creates animated websites, mobile app prototypes, presentations, UI concepts, even motion graphics.
Hold on, motion graphics too?
Yep, and the craziest part is you can use it with almost any AI model you want.
Chat GPT APIs, Claude APIs, local models, whatever.
Incredible. We've reached the point where even the AI tools need customizable AI inside them.
So it's basically AI-powered design with no limits?
Pretty much. And just like Claude Design, it gives you a full interactive canvas
where you keep refining the design through prompts.
That actually sounds insanely useful.
Developers, designers, startup founders.
People are using this stuff to prototype entire ideas in minutes now.
Marvelous.
Humanity reduced months of design meetings into make button look cooler.
And it's really free?
Completely open source.
You can even run it using local models if you want.
Beautiful.
Somewhere a billion dollar SaaS founder just got undercut by a GitHub repo.
Comment design and I'll send you the link directly.
